te: Mars rover Perseverance discovered silica-rich rocks behind Jezero crater
de: The Perseverance rover found light rocks rich in hydrated silica outside Jezero crater. On Earth, it is formed with the participation of water and is able to preserve microscopic fossils. NASA announced the discovery on November 16.

de: In the United States, there is no reason for the food crisis and the need for citizens to create food stocks, as well as the construction of shelters. This was stated by Vice President of the United States Jay D. Vance in an interview with Fox News.

de: In the north-west of Moscow, a teenager died as a result of falling into a ventilation shaft of a house under construction. This is reported by the Metropolitan Prosecutor's Office.

de: Xi Jinping, Vladimir Putin and Donald Trump will discuss "world peace" at a trilateral meeting, China said. Beijing did not specify a specific agenda, but Trump claimed that among the themes would be denuclearization, war with Iran, trade, and more…

d: Третий американский авианосец доставит на Ближний Восток еще тысячи военнослужащих. Президент США колеблется между угрозами нанести удар по Ирану и утверждением, что война "в военном отношении фактически закончена».

de: A third U.S. aircraft carrier will deliver thousands more troops to the Middle East. The US president has vacillated between threatening to strike Iran and claiming that the war is "militarically effectively over."

de: The Argentine footballer died during the match after feeling unwell. It's reported by Need to Know.

t: Швейцария выразила готовность организовать переговоры по Украине
d: Швейцария готова содействовать диалогу и организовать на своей территории переговоры по урегулированию конфликта на Украине. Об этом сообщил ТАСС официальный представитель МИД Швейцарии Йонас Монтани.
te: Switzerland expressed readiness to organize negotiations on Ukraine
de: Switzerland is ready to promote dialogue and organize negotiations on the settlement of the conflict in Ukraine on its territory. This was reported by TASS official representative of the Swiss Foreign Ministry Jonas Montani.

te: Trump is on his first overseas tour since losing the election.
de: Donald Trump embarks on his first foreign trip since his Republican Party's high-profile defeat in the US midterm elections, which could mean renewed focus on foreign policy for the remainder of his term…

d: Энди Бернэм заявил, что Brexit резко снизил авторитет Британии на международной арене. Британский премьер-министр в своей важной внешнеполитической речи намекнул, что лейбористы могут отказаться от "красных линий" в отношении Brexit.

te: The Deputy of the Parliament said about the torture of soldiers of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, who were tied to trees
de: Deputy of the Verkhovna Rada Giorgi Mazurashu reported cases of ill-treatment of servicemen in one of the units of the Armed Forces of Ukraine. According to him, the soldier was tied to trees and kept in this position for several days.

d: Многотысячное шествие, приуроченное к 53-й годовщине жестоко подавленного восстания студентов Афинского политехнического института против военной хунты «черных полковников» в ноябре 1973 года, состоялось во вторник в столице Греции.
te: Thousands of students and trade unions march through central Athens
de: A march of thousands to mark the 53rd anniversary of the brutally suppressed uprising of students of the Athens Polytechnic Institute against the military junta of “black colonels” in November 1973 took place on Tuesday in the Greek capital.
